nodes.body: Resolved after rollback. Investigation confirmed the retry-policy change removed the retry budget and exhausted downstream connections. See the resolution note.

nodes.title: Checkout incident resolution — retry budget regression
nodes.body: Nina confirmed deploy-checkout-retry introduced commit-checkout-retry from pr-checkout-retry. The retry budget was removed, causing downstream connection exhaustion. Rollback restored the 503 rate from 18% to below 0.1%. Restore bounded backoff and add a retry-budget regression test.
